# Version 4.156.3 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering correctness and native hardening**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.3 updates Skia m156 with image-filter, glyph and GPU rendering fixes. The native servicing update also hardens buffer allocation arithmetic without changing managed APIs or the native ABI.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More reliable GPU image rendering** — Prevents Ganesh image filters from sampling unwritten scratch-texture contents through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their bounds. Graphite resets depth tracking after overwriting draws to preserve painter order. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Correct FreeType LCD glyph cropping** — Keeps LCD16 bitmap and mask bounds in matching pixel coordinates, validates the bitmap and crops to their overlap when consecutive glyph loads return different bounds. Outline translation is also guarded against overflow. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))

## Security

- **Checked Ganesh buffer allocations** — Checks buffer alignment and size arithmetic, rejects invalid counts and caps allocations. Allocation failure skips the draw instead of continuing with an invalid buffer. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
